about: Node's evm-rpc HTTP server's answers to the cases of wire-cases.ts (status line, headers in order without Date, body as text up to 1,024 bytes, else its length, SHA-256 and start), with the methods npm run evm-rpc registers (no database) and the test methods of wire-cases.ts, over the recorded indexer. A different answer is a change of Node's behaviour: record the file again on purpose with npx tsx evm-rpc/test/fixtures/record-node-answers.ts.
